title: Case: A high-value shipment lacks an accessible proof-of-delivery record
context: The recipient confirms receipt of a high-value camera accessory, but the order view lacks the handover record. Carrier support may release a redacted inline record to this verified recipient.
initial_request: I did receive the camera accessory. Please obtain the matching handover record so I can reconcile the delivery time in my order history.

events.from: Secure shipment support, Wrenfield Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-1373 belongs to authenticated recipient Ebony Corrigan. Its delivery flag is present but the customer-facing handover record has not populated. We may release the shipment-specific redacted record through this verified thread.
I did receive the camera accessory. Please obtain the matching handover record so I can reconcile the delivery time in my order history.

events.to: Secure shipment support, Wrenfield Arc Logistics
events.body: Please provide the permitted redacted handover record for DL-1373 through Ebony’s verified order thread. Do not expose driver or unrelated recipient personal details.

events.from: Secure shipment support, Wrenfield Arc Logistics
events.body: FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Secure shipment support, Wrenfield Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Record and recipient acknowledgement support this handover only; neither proves contents quality or all future disputes.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-030: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
